plugin.name: HP_MP_Gauges
plugin.author: Claude / modified by ChatGPT
plugin.purpose: Resizable themed cockpit HP and MP gauges
plugin.description:
USAGE:
gauges show : show both gauge windows gauges hide : hide both gauge windows
Automatically updates from lines like: <<OVERALL CONDITION:<HP:100%> <SP:31%><Mob: None> Exp:23.352160%>>
(SP in that line is actually MP, per game's own mislabeling - both gauges are driven straight off the displayed percentages, no separate tracking of exact HP/MP numbers.)
Modular theme client: colours are supplied by UI_Theme_Controller v2.0 when available.

muclient.script:
require "movewindow"
local gaugesVisible = true local hasHPReading = false
PluginID = GetPluginID() HPWin = PluginID .. "_hp" MPWin = PluginID .. "_mp"
-- Same footprint as the chakra indicator light WINDOW_WIDTH = 140 WINDOW_HEIGHT = 155 MIN_GAUGE_WIDTH = 95 MIN_GAUGE_HEIGHT = 105 RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE = 14
HP_WINDOW_WIDTH = math.max(MIN_GAUGE_WIDTH, tonumber(GetVariable("hp_window_width")) or WINDOW_WIDTH) HP_WINDOW_HEIGHT = math.max(MIN_GAUGE_HEIGHT, tonumber(GetVariable("hp_window_height")) or WINDOW_HEIGHT) MP_WINDOW_WIDTH = math.max(MIN_GAUGE_WIDTH, tonumber(GetVariable("mp_window_width")) or WINDOW_WIDTH) MP_WINDOW_HEIGHT = math.max(MIN_GAUGE_HEIGHT, tonumber(GetVariable("mp_window_height")) or WINDOW_HEIGHT) resizeGaugeTarget = nil TITLE_HEIGHT = 18 TITLE_FONT_NAME = "Lucida Console" TITLE_FONT_SIZE = 9 BODY_FONT_NAME = "Lucida Console" BODY_FONT_SIZE = 12
-------------------------------------------------- -- SHARED UI THEMES --------------------------------------------------
THEME_CONTROLLER_ID = "43c8d047be7a418ba5e86916"
THEME_BROADCAST_MESSAGE = 9042
-------------------------------------------------- -- AUTHORITATIVE HP PERCENT BROADCAST -- -- The Theme Controller listens to this instead of parsing the -- condition line a second time. --------------------------------------------------
HP_PERCENT_BROADCAST_MESSAGE = 9043
-------------------------------------------------- -- MODULAR THEME CLIENT -- -- The controller owns the real palette. The local THEMES table -- below is retained only as a safe fallback if the controller -- is unavailable. --------------------------------------------------
local THEME_PROFILE = "gauges"
function ThemeColour( role, fallback )
local rc, value = CallPlugin( THEME_CONTROLLER_ID, "GetThemeColour", THEME_PROFILE, role )
if rc == error_code.eOK and type( value ) == "string" and value ~= "" then
return ColourNameToRGB( value )
end
return ColourNameToRGB( fallback ) end
THEMES = {
classic = { background = "#000000", border = "#E8E8E8", title_bar = "#202020", title_text = "#D4D0C8",
dial_face = "#101010", dial_outer = "#D0D0D0", dial_inner = "#505050",
track = "#333333", tick = "#777777", hub = "#CCCCCC", readout = "#D4D0C8",
mp_active = "#64C8FF", mp_active_dark = "#245C78" },
amber = { background = "#050301", border = "#6B3D18", title_bar = "#160B03", title_text = "#FFB347",
dial_face = "#090501", dial_outer = "#9A571D", dial_inner = "#4A2910",
track = "#2B1708", tick = "#A65F20", hub = "#E38B30", readout = "#FFB347",
mp_active = "#FF9D26", mp_active_dark = "#6B3308" },
default = { background = "#000500", border = "#285B28", title_bar = "#061306", title_text = "#9AFF82",
dial_face = "#000900", dial_outer = "#397A39", dial_inner = "#1C451C",
track = "#0D240D", tick = "#4EA34E", hub = "#72DD72", readout = "#9AFF82",
mp_active = "#67FF67", mp_active_dark = "#176B24" } }
currentTheme = "default"
function LoadTheme()
local theme = GetPluginVariable( THEME_CONTROLLER_ID, "theme" )
if not THEMES[theme] then theme = "default" end
currentTheme = GetPluginVariable( THEME_CONTROLLER_ID, "effective_theme" ) or theme
local T = THEMES[theme]
BACKGROUND_COLOUR = ThemeColour("background", T.background) BORDER_COLOUR = ThemeColour("border", T.border) TITLE_BAR_COLOUR = ThemeColour("title_bar", T.title_bar) TITLE_TEXT_COLOUR = ThemeColour("title_text", T.title_text)
DIAL_FACE_COLOUR = ThemeColour("dial_face", T.dial_face) DIAL_OUTER_COLOUR = ThemeColour("dial_outer", T.dial_outer) DIAL_INNER_COLOUR = ThemeColour("dial_inner", T.dial_inner)
TRACK_COLOUR = ThemeColour("track", T.track) TICK_COLOUR = ThemeColour("tick", T.tick) HUB_COLOUR = ThemeColour("hub", T.hub) READOUT_COLOUR = ThemeColour("readout", T.readout)
MP_ACTIVE_COLOUR = ThemeColour("mp_active", T.mp_active) MP_ACTIVE_DARK = ThemeColour("mp_active_dark", T.mp_active_dark) end
LoadTheme()
-- Gauge geometry RADIUS = 48 DIAL_RADIUS = 54
-------------------------------------------------- -- ALERT SETTINGS --------------------------------------------------
ALERT_RED = ColourNameToRGB("#FF3038") ALERT_DARK_RED = ColourNameToRGB("#4A080B") ALERT_BRIGHT = ColourNameToRGB("#FFD9D9")
hpAlertThreshold = tonumber( GetVariable("hpAlertThreshold") ) or 25
mpAlertThreshold = tonumber( GetVariable("mpAlertThreshold") ) or 20
hpAlertThreshold = math.max( 0, math.min( 100, hpAlertThreshold ) )
mpAlertThreshold = math.max( 0, math.min( 100, mpAlertThreshold ) )
alertFlashOn = false
-------------------------------------------------- -- Gradient helpers (same scheme as the status-line colouring) --------------------------------------------------
local function lerp(c1, c2, t) return math.floor(c1[1] + (c2[1] - c1[1]) * t + 0.5), math.floor(c1[2] + (c2[2] - c1[2]) * t + 0.5), math.floor(c1[3] + (c2[3] - c1[3]) * t + 0.5) end
local function gradient(percent, stops) percent = math.max(0, math.min(100, percent)) for i = 1, #stops - 1 do local p1, c1 = stops[i][1], stops[i][2] local p2, c2 = stops[i + 1][1], stops[i + 1][2] if percent >= p2 and percent <= p1 then local t = (percent - p2) / (p1 - p2) return lerp(c2, c1, t) end end return stops[#stops][2][1], stops[#stops][2][2], stops[#stops][2][3] end
HP_STOPS = { {100, {65, 255, 95}}, {80, {120, 255, 70}}, {60, {225, 245, 55}}, {40, {255, 180, 45}}, {20, {255, 95, 45}}, {0, {255, 45, 55}} }
MP_STOPS = { {100, {60, 235, 255}}, {50, {180, 70, 255}}, {0, {255, 65, 75}} }
AMBER_MP_STOPS = { {100, {255, 210, 120}}, {75, {255, 170, 65}}, {50, {235, 120, 35}}, {25, {180, 72, 18}}, {0, {95, 35, 8}} }
GREEN_MP_STOPS = { {100, {190, 255, 165}}, {75, {105, 235, 105}}, {50, {55, 185, 70}}, {25, {25, 120, 42}}, {0, {10, 65, 22}} }
function ColourForPercent(percent, stops) local r, g, b = gradient(percent, stops) return ColourNameToRGB(string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", r, g, b)) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- NEEDLE / ACTIVE COLOURS --------------------------------------------------
function HPNeedleColour(percent)
if percent < 15 then return ColourNameToRGB("#FF3038") elseif percent < 30 then return ColourNameToRGB("#FF4D4D") elseif percent < 60 then return ColourNameToRGB("#FFB347") else return ColourNameToRGB("#55FF70") end end
function MPGaugeColour(percent)
if currentTheme == "amber" then return ColourForPercent(percent, AMBER_MP_STOPS) elseif currentTheme == "default" then return ColourForPercent(percent, GREEN_MP_STOPS) end
return ColourForPercent(percent, MP_STOPS) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- Drawing helpers - built from WindowLine, since that's proven -- reliable (used since the original chat plugin's borders/arrows), -- rather than relying on untested arc/pie circle modes. --------------------------------------------------
-- percent 0-100 -> angle in degrees, standard math convention -- (0=right, 90=up, 180=left). 0% -> 180 (left), 100% -> 0 (right). function AngleForPercent(percent) percent = math.max(0, math.min(100, percent)) return 180 - (percent / 100) * 180 end
function DrawDialFace(win, centerX, centerY)
-------------------------------------------------- -- Outer instrument bezel --------------------------------------------------
WindowCircleOp( win, miniwin.circle_ellipse, centerX - DIAL_RADIUS - 2, centerY - DIAL_RADIUS - 2, centerX + DIAL_RADIUS + 2, centerY + DIAL_RADIUS + 2, DIAL_OUTER_COLOUR, miniwin.pen_solid, 2, DIAL_OUTER_COLOUR, miniwin.brush_solid )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Inner ring --------------------------------------------------
WindowCircleOp( win, miniwin.circle_ellipse, centerX - DIAL_RADIUS, centerY - DIAL_RADIUS, centerX + DIAL_RADIUS, centerY + DIAL_RADIUS, DIAL_INNER_COLOUR, miniwin.pen_solid, 1, DIAL_FACE_COLOUR, miniwin.brush_solid )
end
function DrawArc(win, centerX, centerY, radius, startAngleDeg, endAngleDeg, colour, penWidth) local steps = 24 local prevX, prevY = nil, nil for i = 0, steps do local t = i / steps local angleDeg = startAngleDeg + (endAngleDeg - startAngleDeg) * t local angleRad = math.rad(angleDeg) local x = centerX + radius * math.cos(angleRad) local y = centerY - radius * math.sin(angleRad) if prevX then WindowLine(win, prevX, prevY, x, y, colour, miniwin.pen_solid, penWidth) end prevX, prevY = x, y end end
function DrawTick(win, centerX, centerY, angleDeg, innerR, outerR, colour) local angleRad = math.rad(angleDeg) local x1 = centerX + innerR * math.cos(angleRad) local y1 = centerY - innerR * math.sin(angleRad) local x2 = centerX + outerR * math.cos(angleRad) local y2 = centerY - outerR * math.sin(angleRad) WindowLine(win, x1, y1, x2, y2, colour, miniwin.pen_solid, 1) end
function DrawNeedle(win, centerX, centerY, angleDeg, length, colour) local angleRad = math.rad(angleDeg) local x = centerX + length * math.cos(angleRad) local y = centerY - length * math.sin(angleRad) WindowLine(win, centerX, centerY, x, y, colour, miniwin.pen_solid, 3) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- RESIZABLE GAUGES --------------------------------------------------
function GaugeDimensions(win) if win == HPWin then return HP_WINDOW_WIDTH, HP_WINDOW_HEIGHT end return MP_WINDOW_WIDTH, MP_WINDOW_HEIGHT end
function SetGaugeDimensions(win, w, h) w = math.max(MIN_GAUGE_WIDTH, math.floor(tonumber(w) or MIN_GAUGE_WIDTH)) h = math.max(MIN_GAUGE_HEIGHT, math.floor(tonumber(h) or MIN_GAUGE_HEIGHT)) if win == HPWin then HP_WINDOW_WIDTH, HP_WINDOW_HEIGHT = w, h else MP_WINDOW_WIDTH, MP_WINDOW_HEIGHT = w, h end end
function SaveGaugeDimensions() SetVariable("hp_window_width", tostring(HP_WINDOW_WIDTH)) SetVariable("hp_window_height", tostring(HP_WINDOW_HEIGHT)) SetVariable("mp_window_width", tostring(MP_WINDOW_WIDTH)) SetVariable("mp_window_height", tostring(MP_WINDOW_HEIGHT)) end
function GaugeResizeMouseDown(flags, hotspot_id) resizeGaugeTarget = hotspot_id == "00_resize_hp" and HPWin or MPWin return 0 end
function UpdateGaugeResize(win) local mouseX = tonumber(WindowInfo(win,17)) local mouseY = tonumber(WindowInfo(win,18)) local left = tonumber(WindowInfo(win,10)) or tonumber(WindowInfo(win,1)) or 0 local top = tonumber(WindowInfo(win,11)) or tonumber(WindowInfo(win,2)) or 0 if not mouseX or not mouseY then return false end local w = math.max(MIN_GAUGE_WIDTH, math.floor(mouseX-left+1)) local h = math.max(MIN_GAUGE_HEIGHT, math.floor(mouseY-top+1)) local ow, oh = GaugeDimensions(win) if w == ow and h == oh then return false end SetGaugeDimensions(win,w,h) WindowResize(win,w,h,BACKGROUND_COLOUR) Redraw() return true end
function GaugeResizeMouseMove(flags, hotspot_id) if resizeGaugeTarget then UpdateGaugeResize(resizeGaugeTarget) end SetCursor(miniwin.cursor_nw_se_arrow) return 0 end
function GaugeResizeMouseUp(flags, hotspot_id) local win = resizeGaugeTarget if win then UpdateGaugeResize(win) end resizeGaugeTarget = nil SaveGaugeDimensions() if win == HPWin then DrawGauge(HPWin,"HP",lastHP,HP_STOPS) else DrawGauge(MPWin,"MP",lastMP,MP_STOPS) end return 0 end
function InstallGaugeResizeHandle(win) local w,h = GaugeDimensions(win) local id = win == HPWin and "00_resize_hp" or "00_resize_mp" WindowDeleteHotspot(win,id) WindowAddHotspot(win,id,w-RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE,h-RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE,w,h, "","","GaugeResizeMouseDown","","","Drag to resize",miniwin.cursor_nw_se_arrow,0) WindowDragHandler(win,id,"GaugeResizeMouseMove","GaugeResizeMouseUp",0) WindowLine(win,w-11,h-3,w-3,h-11,BORDER_COLOUR,miniwin.pen_solid,1) WindowLine(win,w-7,h-3,w-3,h-7,BORDER_COLOUR,miniwin.pen_solid,1) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- CLICK ACTIONS --------------------------------------------------
function UseHighPotion( flags, hotspot_id )
Send("use item hipotion") end
function UseHighEther( flags, hotspot_id )
Send("use item hiether") end
function InstallGaugeHotspot( win, hotspot_id, callback, tooltip )
local gaugeWidth, gaugeHeight = GaugeDimensions(win)
-------------------------------------------------- -- Leave the title bar free for dragging. -- The entire gauge body is clickable. --------------------------------------------------
WindowDeleteHotspot(win, hotspot_id)
WindowAddHotspot( win, hotspot_id,
0, TITLE_HEIGHT,
gaugeWidth, gaugeHeight,
"", "", "", "", callback,
tooltip,
miniwin.cursor_hand, 0 ) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- Window setup --------------------------------------------------
hpWindowInfo = "" mpWindowInfo = ""
function CreateGaugeWindow(win, defaultPos) local gaugeWidth, gaugeHeight = GaugeDimensions(win) check(WindowCreate(win, 0, 0, gaugeWidth, gaugeHeight, 0, 0, BACKGROUND_COLOUR)) check(WindowFont(win, "title"..win, TITLE_FONT_NAME, TITLE_FONT_SIZE, true)) check(WindowFont(win, "body"..win, BODY_FONT_NAME, BODY_FONT_SIZE, true))
local info = movewindow.install(win, defaultPos, miniwin.create_absolute_location, true) WindowCreate(win, info.window_left, info.window_top, gaugeWidth, gaugeHeight, info.window_mode, info.window_flags, BACKGROUND_COLOUR)
movewindow.add_drag_handler(win, 0, 0, 0, TITLE_HEIGHT)
return info end
function DrawGauge(win, label, percent, stops)
WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT = GaugeDimensions(win) local fitRadius = math.floor(math.min((WINDOW_WIDTH - 28) / 2 - 6, (WINDOW_HEIGHT - TITLE_HEIGHT - 20) / 2 - 4)) RADIUS = math.max(22, math.min(54, fitRadius)) DIAL_RADIUS = RADIUS + 6
local alertThreshold
if label == "HP" then alertThreshold = hpAlertThreshold else alertThreshold = mpAlertThreshold end
local alertActive = alertThreshold > 0 and percent <= alertThreshold
WindowRectOp( win, miniwin.rect_fill, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, BACKGROUND_COLOUR )
WindowRectOp( win, miniwin.rect_frame, 0, 0, 0, 0, BORDER_COLOUR )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Title bar --------------------------------------------------
local titleBarColour = TITLE_BAR_COLOUR
local titleTextColour = TITLE_TEXT_COLOUR
local titleText = label
if alertActive then
if alertFlashOn then titleBarColour = ALERT_RED titleTextColour = ColourNameToRGB("#000000") else titleBarColour = ALERT_DARK_RED titleTextColour = ALERT_BRIGHT end
titleText = label .. " ALERT" end
WindowRectOp( win, miniwin.rect_fill, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, TITLE_HEIGHT, titleBarColour )
WindowText( win, "title"..win, titleText, 8, 3, 0, 0, titleTextColour, false )
local centerX = WINDOW_WIDTH / 2 local centerY = TITLE_HEIGHT + 8 + RADIUS
-------------------------------------------------- -- Circular cockpit-style dial behind the gauge. --------------------------------------------------
DrawDialFace( win, centerX, centerY )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Alert ring flashes independently of the current -- terminal theme. --------------------------------------------------
if alertActive then
local alertRingColour
if alertFlashOn then alertRingColour = ALERT_RED else alertRingColour = ALERT_DARK_RED end
WindowCircleOp( win, miniwin.circle_ellipse, centerX - DIAL_RADIUS - 3, centerY - DIAL_RADIUS - 3, centerX + DIAL_RADIUS + 3, centerY + DIAL_RADIUS + 3, alertRingColour, miniwin.pen_solid, 3, 0, miniwin.brush_null ) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- Full semicircular track --------------------------------------------------
DrawArc( win, centerX, centerY, RADIUS, 180, 0, TRACK_COLOUR, 5 )
local fillAngle = AngleForPercent( percent )
local fillColour local needleColour
if label == "HP" then
-------------------------------------------------- -- HP remains semantically colour-coded regardless -- of terminal theme. --------------------------------------------------
fillColour = ColourForPercent( percent, HP_STOPS )
needleColour = HPNeedleColour( percent )
else
-------------------------------------------------- -- MP keeps its original gradient in Default. -- Amber/Green use the selected terminal phosphor. --------------------------------------------------
fillColour = MPGaugeColour( percent )
needleColour = fillColour
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- Active portion of track --------------------------------------------------
DrawArc( win, centerX, centerY, RADIUS, 180, fillAngle, fillColour, 7 )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Five major ticks --------------------------------------------------
for _, tickPercent in ipairs( {0, 25, 50, 75, 100} ) do
local angle = AngleForPercent( tickPercent )
DrawTick( win, centerX, centerY, angle, RADIUS + 2, RADIUS + 8, TICK_COLOUR ) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- Additional small ticks give it a more mechanical -- instrument feel without making the face busy. --------------------------------------------------
for tickPercent = 10, 90, 10 do
if tickPercent % 25 ~= 0 then
local angle = AngleForPercent( tickPercent )
DrawTick( win, centerX, centerY, angle, RADIUS + 4, RADIUS + 7, TICK_COLOUR )
end
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- Needle --------------------------------------------------
DrawNeedle( win, centerX, centerY, fillAngle, RADIUS * 0.82, needleColour )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Hub: dark outer cap + themed inner cap --------------------------------------------------
WindowCircleOp( win, miniwin.circle_ellipse, centerX - 5, centerY - 5, centerX + 5, centerY + 5, DIAL_INNER_COLOUR, miniwin.pen_solid, 1, DIAL_INNER_COLOUR, miniwin.brush_solid )
WindowCircleOp( win, miniwin.circle_ellipse, centerX - 3, centerY - 3, centerX + 3, centerY + 3, HUB_COLOUR, miniwin.pen_solid, 1, HUB_COLOUR, miniwin.brush_solid )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Numeric readout --------------------------------------------------
local readoutText = tostring( math.floor( percent + 0.5 ) ) .. "%"
local textWidth = WindowTextWidth( win, "body"..win, readoutText )
local readoutColour = fillColour
if alertActive and alertFlashOn then readoutColour = ALERT_RED end
WindowText( win, "body"..win, readoutText, centerX - (textWidth / 2), centerY + 18, 0, 0, readoutColour, false )
InstallGaugeHotspot( win, win == HPWin and "hp_use_high_potion" or "mp_use_high_ether", win == HPWin and "UseHighPotion" or "UseHighEther", win == HPWin and "Use a High Potion (use item hipotion)" or "Use a High Ether (use item hiether)" ) InstallGaugeResizeHandle(win)
WindowShow( win, gaugesVisible )
Redraw() end
-------------------------------------------------- -- Trigger handler --------------------------------------------------
lastHP = 100 lastMP = 100
-- Return only an observed HP value, never the initial display placeholder. function GetCurrentHPPercent() if hasHPReading then return lastHP end return nil end
function OnConditionLine(name, line, wildcards) local hp = tonumber(wildcards[1]) local mp = tonumber(wildcards[2])
if hp then lastHP = hp hasHPReading = true
DrawGauge( HPWin, "HP", hp, HP_STOPS )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Share the exact HP percentage already parsed by this -- proven gauge trigger. --------------------------------------------------
BroadcastPlugin( HP_PERCENT_BROADCAST_MESSAGE, tostring( hp ) ) end
if mp then lastMP = mp DrawGauge(MPWin, "MP", mp, MP_STOPS) end end
-------------------------------------------------- -- Plugin lifecycle --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginInstall() LoadTheme()
hpWindowInfo = CreateGaugeWindow(HPWin, miniwin.pos_top_right) mpWindowInfo = CreateGaugeWindow(MPWin, miniwin.pos_bottom_right)
InstallGaugeHotspot( HPWin, "hp_use_high_potion", "UseHighPotion", "Use a High Potion (use item hipotion)" )
InstallGaugeHotspot( MPWin, "mp_use_high_ether", "UseHighEther", "Use a High Ether (use item hiether)" )
DrawGauge(HPWin, "HP", lastHP, HP_STOPS) DrawGauge(MPWin, "MP", lastMP, MP_STOPS) end
function OnPluginSaveState() SaveGaugeDimensions() movewindow.save_state(HPWin) movewindow.save_state(MPWin)
SetVariable( "hpAlertThreshold", tostring(hpAlertThreshold) )
SetVariable( "mpAlertThreshold", tostring(mpAlertThreshold) ) end
function OnPluginEnable() LoadTheme()
DrawGauge(HPWin, "HP", lastHP, HP_STOPS) DrawGauge(MPWin, "MP", lastMP, MP_STOPS)
WindowShow(HPWin, gaugesVisible) WindowShow(MPWin, gaugesVisible) end
function OnPluginDisable() WindowShow(HPWin, false) WindowShow(MPWin, false) end
function gauges_show(name, line, wildcards) gaugesVisible = true WindowShow(HPWin, true) WindowShow(MPWin, true) ColourNote("yellow", "", "Gauges shown.") end
function gauges_hide(name, line, wildcards) gaugesVisible = false WindowShow(HPWin, false) WindowShow(MPWin, false) ColourNote("yellow", "", "Gauges hidden.") end
-------------------------------------------------- -- ALERT CONFIGURATION --------------------------------------------------
function SetAlertThreshold(which, value)
value = tonumber(value)
if not value then return end
value = math.floor(value)
if value < 0 or value > 100 then
ColourNote( "red", "", "Alert percentage must be between 0 and 100." )
return end
if which == "HP" then
hpAlertThreshold = value
SetVariable( "hpAlertThreshold", tostring(value) )
else
mpAlertThreshold = value
SetVariable( "mpAlertThreshold", tostring(value) )
end
DrawGauge( HPWin, "HP", lastHP, HP_STOPS )
DrawGauge( MPWin, "MP", lastMP, MP_STOPS )
if value == 0 then
ColourNote( "yellow", "", which .. " alert disabled." )
else
ColourNote( "yellow", "", which .. " alert set to " .. tostring(value) .. "%." )
end end
function alert_hp( name, line, wildcards )
SetAlertThreshold( "HP", wildcards[1] ) end
function alert_mp( name, line, wildcards )
SetAlertThreshold( "MP", wildcards[1] ) end
function alert_status( name, line, wildcards )
ColourNote( "yellow", "", "Gauge alerts: HP " .. tostring(hpAlertThreshold) .. "%, MP " .. tostring(mpAlertThreshold) .. "%." ) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- ALERT FLASH TIMER --------------------------------------------------
function GaugeAlertTick()
local hpAlert = hpAlertThreshold > 0 and lastHP <= hpAlertThreshold
local mpAlert = mpAlertThreshold > 0 and lastMP <= mpAlertThreshold
if not hpAlert and not mpAlert then
if alertFlashOn then alertFlashOn = false end
return end
alertFlashOn = not alertFlashOn
if hpAlert then DrawGauge( HPWin, "HP", lastHP, HP_STOPS ) end
if mpAlert then DrawGauge( MPWin, "MP", lastMP, MP_STOPS ) end end
-------------------------------------------------- -- THEME BROADCAST --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginBroadcast( msg, id, name, text )
if msg ~= THEME_BROADCAST_MESSAGE then return end
if id ~= THEME_CONTROLLER_ID then return end
LoadTheme()
DrawGauge( HPWin, "HP", lastHP, HP_STOPS )
DrawGauge( MPWin, "MP", lastMP, MP_STOPS ) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- PLUGIN CONTROLLER LAYOUT API --------------------------------------------------
function ManagedLayoutParse(spec) local windowName, sx, sy, sw, sh = tostring(spec or ""):match("^([^\t]+)\t(-?%d+)\t(-?%d+)\t(%d+)\t(%d+)$") if not windowName then return nil end return windowName, tonumber(sx), tonumber(sy), tonumber(sw), tonumber(sh) end
function ManagedLayoutSetMoveWindowInfo(info, winName, x, y) if type(info) ~= "table" then return end info.window_left = x info.window_top = y info.window_mode = tonumber(WindowInfo(winName, 7)) or info.window_mode or miniwin.pos_top_left info.window_flags = tonumber(WindowInfo(winName, 8)) or info.window_flags or miniwin.create_absolute_location end
function GetManagedLayoutWindows() return HPWin .. string.char(30) .. MPWin end
function ApplyManagedLayout(spec) local windowName, x, y, w, h = ManagedLayoutParse(spec) if windowName ~= HPWin and windowName ~= MPWin then return "wrong window" end
SetGaugeDimensions(windowName, w, h) SaveGaugeDimensions()
-- The layout API must resize the REAL miniwindow, not just the -- variables used by DrawGauge(). Otherwise the resize grip is -- installed beyond the physical window edge. local physicalW, physicalH = GaugeDimensions(windowName) WindowResize( windowName, physicalW, physicalH, BACKGROUND_COLOUR )
local info if windowName == HPWin then info = hpWindowInfo else info = mpWindowInfo end
ManagedLayoutSetMoveWindowInfo(info, windowName, x, y)
if windowName == HPWin then DrawGauge(HPWin, "HP", lastHP, HP_STOPS) else DrawGauge(MPWin, "MP", lastMP, MP_STOPS) end
local mode = type(info) == "table" and info.window_mode or miniwin.pos_top_left local flags = type(info) == "table" and info.window_flags or miniwin.create_absolute_location WindowPosition(windowName, x, y, mode, flags) if movewindow then movewindow.save_state(windowName) end pcall(SaveState) Redraw() return "ok" end
